meta.note: PharmGKB 已整站跳转到 ClinPGx（同名 SPA）。本册补齐 clingen/clingen2 之外的深页：检索筛选面板的实体/注释类型、变异页事实标签与人群频率表、说明书注释页的固定句、下载页的说明段与归档链接、404 固定文案。基因/变异/药物名、HGVS、rsID、accession、人群缩写、论文标题与机构名一律保留英文。

templates.pat: ClinPGx data and knowledge are available as download files. We have found that it is often critical for users to check with our team at {{1}} before embarking on a large project using these data to be sure that the files and data we make available are being interpreted correctly. We generally do not need to be a co-author on such analyses; we just want to make sure that there is a correct understanding of our data before lots of resources are spent.
templates.zh: ClinPGx 的数据与知识以可下载文件的形式提供。我们发现，用户在启动大规模项目前通常最好先通过 {{1}} 与我们团队确认，以确保对我们提供的文件与数据有正确的理解。此类分析一般不需要我们作为共同作者；我们只是希望在投入大量资源之前，确保我们的数据被正确理解。

templates.pat: {{1}}{{2}} is a comprehensive resource supporting the clinical implementation of pharmacogenomics (PGx), the study of how genetic variation affects medication response. We provide expert curation of PGx genes, variants, drugs, and gene–drug relationships, plus guidelines and tools that make PGx accessible, understandable, and actionable in clinical practice. ClinPGx is home to the Clinical Pharmacogenetics Implementation Consortium ({{3}}{{4}}).
templates.zh: {{1}}{{2}} 是一个综合资源，支持药物基因组学（PGx）的临床落地，即研究遗传变异如何影响药物反应。我们提供对 PGx 基因、变异、药物及基因-药物关系的专家策展，以及让 PGx 在临床实践中可及、易懂、可执行的指南与工具。它是临床药物遗传学实施联盟（{{3}}{{4}}）的所在地。
